scope: Fresh isolated Chrome, fixed synthetic data and mocked services; no real user database, external services or device installation.

checks.name: stock/fund tabs switch the saved view while keeping the unified daily-check entry
holding and trigger totals use the same verified quote summaries as the existing checks
pricing formula shows gross/net dividend and the 5% reference; four buy/four sell levels and folded reference metrics preserve the saved plan
inline allocation rejects excess weight, then updates only the selected stock weight
list removal requires two clicks and removing an unfunded stock preserves other allocations
the existing holding guard still blocks removal from the new list shortcut
the two-step editor preserves conflict rejection and cannot overwrite a newer plan
back/next retains the draft and a normal save preserves grids, quote, shares and pause
